newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds Metals may sell unit to AmeriMark.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds Metals may sell unit to AmeriMark.

text.p: Reynolds Metals Co said AmeriMark Inc of Raleigh, N.C., signed a letter of intent to buy Reynolds' residential construction products business in the U.S. and Canada. Terms were not disclosed.

As part of the transaction, Reynolds would sell its alumunium mini mill in Chesterfield County, Virginia; its metal fabricating plant in Ashville, Ohio; its vinyl replacement window assembly factory in Bourbon, Ill.; its vinyl siding plant in Lynchburg, Va.; its manufactured housing operations in Eastman, Ga.; and distribution centers in the U.S. and Canada, it said.
